decisive_items: 4 symmetric concentric ring-shaped opacities in posterior corneal stroma
long bandlike structures with thin streaks of white lines interspersed
response.rationale: The combination of ring-shaped opacities in the posterior corneal stroma and the specific findings on laser scanning in vivo confocal microscopy, including long bandlike structures with thin streaks of white lines, is more consistent with corneal amyloidosis than the other options.

rejected.why: While crocodile shagreen is present, it is not the primary diagnostic feature in this case.
